# NewDocumentDialog

**Class:** `UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Pick a file type to create, from a filterable list

## Overview

@brief Dialog for creating new documents with file type selection @example auto dialog = CreateNewDocumentDialog("NewDocDlg", 1, 100, 100); dialog->onDocumentCreated = [](const NewDocumentResult& result) { ... }; dialog->Show();

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog> CreateNewDocumentDialog( const std::string& identifier, int x = 100, int y = 100, int width = 500, int height = 450 );   // @brief Create a new document dialog (calls Initialize() automatically)
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog> CreateProgrammingNewDocumentDialog( const std::string& identifier, int x = 100, int y = 100 );   // @brief Create dialog pre-loaded with programming language types
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height);
UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog(const std::string& identifier, float width, float height);
explicit UltraCanvasNewDocumentDialog(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

|---|---|---|
| `onDocumentCreated` | `std::function<void(const NewDocumentResult&)> onDocumentCreated` | _Document created_ |

| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const DocumentTypeInfo*)> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |
